CORE/TERMS-QUERY (Terms Query, WordPress 6.9+) core/query for taxonomy terms: a list of categories, tags or custom terms, each drawn by the blocks you place in its term-template. Use it for "Browse by topic" lists and term menus. REQUIRED STRUCTURE (like core/query > core/post-template) core/terms-query (WHICH terms) > core/term-template (HOW ONE term looks; repeated per term). Inside the template: core/term-name, core/term-count, core/term-description, alone or in a group. Unlike core/query there is NO pagination and NO "no results" block: with no terms the list renders nothing. THE termQuery ATTRIBUTE (write all eight keys, in this order) perPage: how many terms; 0 = all. taxonomy: "category", "post_tag" or a custom taxonomy slug. orderBy/order: "name"+"asc"|"desc" or "count"+"desc"|"asc". include: term ids to show only those, in that order (order and showNested are then ignored). hideEmpty: true skips terms with no posts. showNested: false = top-level terms only of a hierarchical taxonomy; true = all levels. inherit: true = on a term archive template, the current term's child terms (non-hierarchical: all terms of its taxonomy); anywhere else it falls back to this block's own conditions.
